best_idea: Gate each chat command with a per-player, per-command window that is written only when the command is accepted, so a refused attempt cannot extend the wait, and let staff bypass it.
decision_why: The accepted-only command window and the sender-side whisper receive gate are sound; the donor checks mute per command so whisper, chat groups and private messages skip it, its receive gate is silent to the sender, and it is GPL-3.0 so clean-room only. Keep the windows, put mute in one intake function, and tell the sender on refusal.
acceptance: Server test: two whispers within 500 ms give one delivery, the second is refused as slow and does not reset the window; a muted player's whisper, group chat line and private message are each refused; a whisper from an ignoring target is not delivered and the sender gets the same success reply as a delivered one.
